system: One sentence: what the product does and for whom.

abuse_cases.text: As a member I read or change another customer's document by changing the id.
As a visitor I guess passwords or find out which emails have an account.
As a visitor I send a forged payment webhook to get a paid plan.
abuse_cases.test: tests/webhooks.test: unsigned and replayed events are refused

abuse_cases.text: As a member I upload a file that runs as a page or a script when opened.
abuse_cases.test: manual: upload .html and .svg with a script, open the stored file

abuse_cases.text: As a member I open the admin area or call its API.
As a member I run up the bill of a usage-billed service with a loop of requests.
abuse_cases.test: manual: quota reached after N requests

abuse_cases.text: As a visitor I flood the site until it stops answering.
abuse_cases.why: No protection beyond the host's until the first paying customer; decided by the founder, to revisit at launch.
